'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|You're doing great! But it's too early to stop. Shine your face more often, impress the audience. Stand out. Become the one they talk about, the one they come to see. Then the cash will come, and then other goodies: cars, girls... Although Tarkov is a little short on the latter. Anyway, the Arena is a great career opportunity right now, ha!}}

==Objectives==
* Win 2 matches while claiming at least 3rd place in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in [[Arena]]

==Rewards==
* +4,500 [[EXP]]
* [[Ref]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 28 [[GP coin]]s
** 29 [[GP coin]]s with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 32 [[GP coin]]s with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 1× [[Valuables crate (Rare)]]
* Unlocks the [[Arena]] item transfer service on [[Ref]] for main characters
{{quote|And now you're one step closer to the big leagues! Respect, brother.}}
